sentences.en: Despite the importance of sleep, its purpose is a mystery.
sentences.zh: 尽管睡眠很重要，但它的作用仍然是一个谜。

sentences.en: Why people fall into these categories, however, is a mystery.
sentences.zh: 然而，人们为什么会归入这些类别却是一个谜。

sentences.en: Who is able to reveal the mysteries of the sea?
sentences.zh: 谁能够揭示大海的奥秘呢？

senses.zh: 神秘(性), 秘密(性) - 神秘的事, 难以理解的事物 - 来历不明[难探究竟]的人
